ns2:section.sectionText: "This is a blended/hybrid course: partly in-person, partly online. While we will use the meeting time/place arranged by the university for several class sessions, this will be the exception rather than the rule. Most of the work will be online and asynchronous, and our scheduled face-to-face times will be used primarily for book club meetings of fewer than ten students per meeting. All students should keep those times free for this course until they have been assigned to a book club during the early weeks of the course. Book club meetings will be held in smaller seminar rooms to be determined."
